maddeler.e:
هننت (form I)
# هَنَنْتُ (hanantu) /ha.nan.tu/: first-person singular past active of هَنَّ (hanna)
# هَنَنْتَ (hananta) /ha.nan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of هَنَّ (hanna)
# هَنَنْتِ (hananti) /ha.nan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of هَنَّ (hanna)
# هُنِنْتُ (hunintu) /hu.nin.tu/: first-person singular past passive of هَنَّ (hanna)
# هُنِنْتَ (huninta) /hu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
